thread:
Amy: Heads-up — AcmeHealth auditor requested POC evidence packet. Items: 1) a data-flow diagram showing which Redwood services touch PHI, 2) list of in-scope infra/components for SOC2/ISO, 3) signed pen-test attestation (who can sign & timeline), 4) what cert metadata we can share for on-prem (CN/issuer/thumbprint?), 5) pricing impact if they want reserved staging capacity. Deadline: next Tue EOD. Anyone see blockers?

Raj: I can produce a diagram with subnets + CIDRs and the security group / firewall rules. Question: do they want host-level IPs or just service CIDRs?

Amy: Auditor said service-level flows + CIDR ranges and flags for "in scope" assets is fine. They want traceability between diagram and asset list.

Marta (Security): Pen-test attestation: Security can sign a standard template. Legal must approve any customer-specific language. Typical line: "Redwood Inference attests a penetration test was completed on <date> covering systems listed in the attached scope; findings were reviewed and addressed as noted." Signed letter ready ~3 business days after final report. If Acme needs the vendorull report, we need NDA + vendor consent (~2 extra days).

Chad (Solutions): Pricing: if they request reserved staging hosts for isolation, we need to add a dedicated host premium (roughly +25-40% depending on GPU class). For a short POC recommend ephemeral burst capacity — cheaper and avoids reserved commit. I can produce a POC quote comparing ephemeral vs reserved once Amy confirms expected vGPU count / peak QPS.

Amy: SSL certs / KMS: they want proof certs are customer-managed for Private. For on-prem POC they asked whether we can share CN + issuer or if we should limit to thumbprint only.

Marta (Security): We can provide CN and issuer, and a redacted key thumbprint. Never share private keys or internal rotation scripts. For KMS proof we can provide key metadata and a short runbook of rotation + ACLs (screenshots redacted for customer identifiers require Legal sign-off).

Raj: Sample SG snippet I'll include in diagram export:
```
- lb-subnet (10.0.1.0/24) -> app-subnet (10.0.2.0/24): allow 443
- app-subnet -> db-subnet (10.0.3.0/24): allow 5432
- peered-acme (172.16.0.0/16): allow 443 from whitelisted hosts
```
I'll upload PNG + draw.io XML by EOD today.

Redwood Bot: Uploaded file: pen-test-attestation-template.pdf to https://drive.redwood.example/attestations/4260001111 (owner: Marta) :white_check_mark:

Marta (Security): Uploaded a redlined attestation template. I'll also produce a 1-page "in-scope assets" list that matches Raj's diagram. Legal to review signature block.

Chad (Solutions): Amy — once you confirm expected POC capacity Ican draft the ephemeral vs reserved cost comparison and note SLA/perf variance for ephemeral.

Amy: Actions: Raj -> network diagram + SG rules (EOD today). Marta -> attestation + in-scope list (tomorrow). Chad -> cost split quote (EOD). I'll assemble and send to Acme auditor by Monday AM. If Acme requests vendor full report, we'll require NDA + vendor approval which may push timeline.

Marta (Security): FYI if they ask for CT logs or cert transparency we can include public CT entries. Private cert data not shareable.

Amy: Thanks everyone. :pray:
